## Independent Codex review — Request changes

Reviewed **b48cde8e70b9ab47f68056d29be89a28d604b0df**, PR #3192 / BUG-2383 (canonical origin `BUG-b6b1278890774ef993d2ebc327862470-157`). Fresh forge head confirmed unchanged before recording. Full forge merge-base diff reviewed across all 16 changed files; merge base and current PR base are `9d26f95d2b36d75678a4b37e279e2b175be2f0a9` (0 commits behind that base). This is a new independent review, not a continuation or adoption of the quota-exhausted Claude attempt.

### Blocking findings (complete sweep, consolidated once)

1. **[P1] Regenerate the help golden from the actual command tree.** `aida-cli-lib/src/tests/golden/cli_help_snapshot.txt:373` is inconsistent with the rendered help. Current-head `CI (lib-0)` fails `command_registry::story_1728_command_registry_tests::help_surface_matches_golden_snapshot` at `story_1728_command_registry_tests.rs:103`: the expected `lane` line at this position is absent in actual output. The patch also hand-adds the nested help/catalog entries; regenerate and review the whole snapshot rather than patching only the first mismatch. Preserve the gate.
2. **[P1] Remove the new raw executable lookup.** `aida-cli-lib/src/tests/bug_2383_lane_job_tests.rs:708` calls `std::env::current_exe()`. Current-head `CI (lib-0)` fails `orchestrator_leases::resolve_aida_exe_tests::no_cli_source_outside_the_resolver_uses_raw_current_executable_lookup` (`resolve_aida_exe_tests.rs:65`), reporting exactly this file, count 1 instead of 0. Use the existing resolver/fixture convention without weakening the ratchet.
3. **[P1] Use the executable-fixture helper at all five new sites.** `bug_2383_lane_job_tests.rs:192,390,493,562,818` directly use `Permissions::from_mode(0o755)`. The actual failing `CI (gates)` step is **Executable fixture ratchet**, `tests.test_executable_fixture_ratchet.ExecutableFixtureRatchetTests.test_test_sources_do_not_set_executable_modes_directly`: it reports these five sites and requires `test_exec::mark_executable`. The earlier `stray/`/`leak` stderr comes from the passing STORY-1853 tooling fixtures; it is not this failure's cause. The current contracts lane passes, so the previous manual-drift failure is not repeated as a current blocker.
4. **[P1] Do not report compile/offline failures as tested.** `lane_job.rs:340-352,943-944` calls `Tally::record_exit` for every normal process exit, regardless of rc or whether any test started; `runs_tests` only checks argv. A `cargo test` failing to resolve an offline dependency, compile, parse its manifest, or start a test binary exits normally (commonly 101), and therefore clears `untested=true` even though no local test ran. This contradicts AC3 and the new docs' explicit promise that a missing host-fetched dependency reports untested. The `--no-run`, `--list`, and signal fixes are useful but insufficient; a zero-match filter is another no-test case. Preserve genuine failing-test evidence while distinguishing pre-test failures/no executed tests. Add runner/tally regressions for these cases; the current fake-cargo pass/fail fixture only simulates a test result.
5. **[P1] Decouple vendor-neutral drain job setup from the Claude-only resume eligibility helper.** In `session.rs:4643-4650,4694-4709`, both offering the runner and recording the drain untested marker depend on `drain_resume_lane`. That helper at `session.rs:4727-4736` explicitly returns `None` for Codex and Antigravity; the existing `only_a_claude_implementer_lane_gets_the_drain_resume_loop` test expressly confirms it. Thus a Codex implementer drain gets no runner, no job env/contract, and no untested marker. `phase_driver_trait.rs:525` treats a missing marker as no warning. This violates the binding vendor-neutral ruling (Claude and Codex use the same path) and the drain AC1/AC3 surface. Keep resume policy separate, offer/record jobs for eligible implementer vendors, and add a launcher/drain fixture verifying env, prompt, job completion/refusal and phase output. `a_drain_lane_records_whether_it_ran_a_test` only tests marker file helpers, not this wiring. Missing/unreadable evidence must not silently imply tested.
6. **[P2] Make the containment regression mandatory in the live-bwrap gate.** `bug_2383_lane_job_tests.rs:701-705` silently returns success when bwrap is unavailable and does not honor `AIDA_REQUIRE_BWRAP_LIVE`. `.github/workflows/ci.yml:299-314` only selects/counts the older named filters, excluding `a_sandboxed_job_cannot_change_a_host_dependency_build_script`. Its ordinary shard may therefore pass by skipping before the gates shard enables user namespaces. Wire this regression into the forced-live selection/count and refuse a skip there; include actual host bin/config write attempts alongside registry/src and git/checkouts. The current argv test checks those paths lexically, while the live test attacks only the two source trees. The security ruling requires proven host-source/bin/config isolation, not a potentially skipped pass.

### Acceptance and security ruling sweep

| Requirement | Assessment at reviewed head |
|---|---|
| AC1 sanctioned background test, slot limiter, bounded polling | Runner thread, argv submission, 50s default / 55s maximum polling, timeout and slot-wrapper resolution exist. `fixture_lane_runs_a_filtered_test_through_the_runner_and_reports_pass_fail` and `a_job_takes_the_cargo_slot_through_the_limiter_on_path` inspect the protocol using fake cargo and the test-only unwrapped sandbox. Drain/vendor gap remains (5); no actual Cargo invocation was performed in this review. |
| AC2 warm target | `seat_target_seed.rs:85-221` uses only `cp -a --reflink=always`, no hardlink/plain-copy fallback; `session_start.rs` seeds on launch and the runner retries before its first job. The inode/control-write regression covers seed isolation when reflinks work. The binding corrected ruling permits a cold build when unsupported; cold default timeout is now 3600s. |
| AC3 prompt and honest untested result | Shared `LANE_JOB_CONTRACT` and standalone `with_untested` exist. Test-only tally excludes no-run/list and signal termination. Remaining false-tested and drain coverage defects are (4) and (5). |
| AC4 fixture + invalid argv refusal | Named filtered pass/fail and invalid-command/symlink refusal fixtures exist and were read in full. They use fake cargo with `Sandbox::TestUnwrapped`; they do not prove a sandboxed headless drain can submit/read a job. Launcher regression required in (5), live containment evidence in (6). |
| Whole host Cargo home RO/offline | `sandbox_rw_paths` omits all Cargo home paths, including registry/cache/src and git/db/checkouts; jobs set `CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true`. Production bwrap rw paths are the seat, its own target, and slot state. Earlier writable-host-cache finding is corrected in code; mandatory runtime evidence is incomplete (6). |
| Cleared environment, no authority forwarding | `env_clear()` plus filtered host/build/request env; no `AIDA_SESSION_GRANT`, session/handle, SSH socket or forge-token forwarding. Allow-list tests inspect both construction and child env. No grant/provenance floor changes in the diff. |
| Fail closed; no unconfined production fallback | `offer` rejects os_wrap-off, wrapper preflights bwrap, execution refuses unavailable sandbox. Unwrapped execution is `#[cfg(test)]` only. Refusal regression exists. |
| Traceability / docs | Implementation/tests carry BUG-2383 traces, command registry/audit/manual/pickup docs updated. PR body is stale about hardlinks and should be refreshed to describe the final reflink-only, offline sandbox design. |

### CI and validation

Fresh forge CI remains **red and a ship blocker**: `CI (lib-0)`, `CI (gates)`, required aggregate `Build (ubuntu-latest)`, and `merge-hold-gate` fail. The merge-hold log reports the existing active hold; I have not cleared it. Other library/CLI/rest/contracts lanes pass. No CI waiting, implementation, merge, Cargo execution, raw ledger writes, or dispatch was performed. Review used the full actual diff, actual pinned source and named tests, fresh run metadata and complete logs; the three CI failures above are observed, and findings 4–6 are code/workflow-grounded review results.

CI evidence: [current-head run](https://github.com/joemooney/aida/actions/runs/41286108225), [lib-0](https://github.com/joemooney/aida/actions/runs/41286108225/job/124787621277), [gates](https://github.com/joemooney/aida/actions/runs/41286108225/job/124787621302), [merge-hold](https://github.com/joemooney/aida/actions/runs/41286108238/job/124787620830).

**Verdict: Request changes.** All blockers above belong to this owning spec; no containment floor is accepted as a deferred follow-up. Recording uses the supported AIDA writer under my own fresh validated reviewer context, pinned to the full SHA. Turn ends after the review and advisor notification; no callback or CI watch remains active.
